shared_style: Cinematic live-action comedy shot like a solemn will reading, 35mm, shallow depth of field, slight film grain, deep shadows. Office scenes: a wood-panelled lawyer's office at dusk, warm tungsten from one green banker's lamp, rain-blue window light. Payoff scene: soft natural daylight in a calm, modern kitchen. Australian people, natural performances, nobody looks at the camera. Framed for widescreen and a tall portrait crop: the subject and every action sit in the centre third. One continuous shot, no cuts. Absolutely no readable text, letters, words or numbers anywhere, no logos.

voice.narrator_direction: A calm, warm Australian voice in the late 40s, unhurried and plain, like a sensible friend explaining a form; never salesy. Says the name as 'ideal ex'.
voice.lawyer_direction: A dry, measured Australian man in his late 50s, formal and deadpan, reading slowly with long pauses.
voice.trustee_direction: An Australian woman in her mid 40s, polite and hopeful, a small rise on the question.
voice.plan: Dialogue generated with its shot so the lips match, each speaker locked with a short audio reference; narrator payoff and risk line as one take on a plain carrier.
